output.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS late_payments
FROM marts.fct_payments p
JOIN marts.fct_orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id
WHERE p.method = 'invoice'
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND (p.paid_at - o.order_date) > 30
output.explanation: Counts invoice payments for orders placed in 2025 where days to pay (paid_at - order_date) is more than 30. All order statuses are included because the question is about payments, not revenue.
